translations.web: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.
translations.bsb: He does not take His eyes off the righteous, but He enthrones them with kings and exalts them forever.
translations.kjv: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.
translations.asv: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: But with kings upon the throne He setteth them for ever, and they are exalted.
